text:
cheng: quick handoff — I'm logging off in 40m. leaving the kernel warmup + kv-prefetch work in a shippable state. PR is up: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/2345, branch: feat/kv-prefetch-warmup. main open items below.

maria: thanks — quick checklist?

cheng: 1) CI flaky test 'kv_cache_eviction.test_evict_on_pressure' failing intermittently; happens ~1/50. stacktrace in PR. 2) canary config for continuous batching needs route limit lowered to 250 -> currently 500. 3) perf regression on sequence=2048 in nightly (p99 +6ms), looks related to new kernel reorder.

sam: i'll take the flaky test first thing. adding myself to PR reviewers. can you point to the failing test log?

cheng: pasted the failing unit log below.

cheng: ```
E AssertionError: expected 12 evictions but saw 9
  at tests/kv_cache_eviction.py:87
  last ops: evict_on_pressure -> resize_pool
```

maria: @sam TY. Sam — if you need a repro, use the local repro script: `./dev/repro_kv.sh --seed 42 --size 2048` (it reproduces ~80% on my machine).

alex: quick note on canary config — lowering route limit requires infra change to autoscaler policy (ticket INF-982). @priya can infra accept a manual override for 2h for the canary window?

priya: INF-982 updated. we can do manual override today 15:00-17:00 PT. need owners to ack rollback plan.

maria: rollback plan: revert PR -> fallback model variant (v1.3) + scale down batch window. I'll own rollback steps.

sam: on flaky test — found race in test harness; pushing fix in a separate commit. will kick CI. once green, I'll request merge.

cheng: awesome. on perf regression: i've added a micro-benchmark script in the PR to compare kernel reorder paths. please run `python tools/bench_kernel.py --model small --seq 2048` and paste results.

alex: ran bench locally. small model p99: baseline 18ms -> new 24ms. looks like additional memcpy in hotpath. filing RT-5123 for kernel memcpy optimization and linking to PR.

priya: infra will hold the override until SAM confirms CI green and MARIA confirms rollback doc exists.

sam: CI is green on my branch -> test fix merged to PR. created PR comment: "fixed race in test harness". requesting final review from @maria @cheng.

maria: looking now. small nit in docstring, otherwise LGTM. i'll merge after we validate canary config change (alex + priya). :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled at 2026-03-18T15:05:00Z for feat/kv-prefetch-warmup -> route=canary-ops-42 (manual override INF-982 applied).

cheng: final asks before i log: 
- @priya confirm override set at 15:00 PT
- @alex confirm RT-5123 has owners and ETA
- @maria you'll own rollback

priya: override set. infra on-call monitoring during window.

alex: RT-5123 assigned to me + kyle. ETA EOD tomorrow for initial memcpy micro-optim. will post benchmarks.

maria: rollback doc is in PR under /docs/canary-rollback.md. i'll be on standby during window.

cheng: perfect. i'll sign off now. if anything blows up ping on mobile. thanks all. :heart: 

sam: thanks — i'll shepherd the merge + watch canary.

maria: thanks team.
